name: Nha Trang Cathedral
kicker: The stone cathedral on Thái Nguyên
summary: Nhà thờ Núi, also the cathedral, is at 31A Thái Nguyên in Phước Tân. The provincial digital guide prints information hours of 05:00–17:00 and no ticket. Construction started on 3 September 1928. One sentence dates the inauguration to 14 March 1933. The contact block says founded 14 May 1933. Both dates stay.
getThere: 31A Thái Nguyên, Phước Tân. Minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: The stone clock tower and the arched front of the cathedral
body: The provincial digital guide calls it Nhà thờ Núi and Nhà thờ Chánh tòa. The address is 31A Thái Nguyên, Phước Tân. The information block prints 05:00–17:00. No ticket is printed. Weekday Mass is 4:45 and 17:00. Sunday Mass is 5:00, 7:00, 9:30, 16:30, and 18:30. The patronal feast is the feast of Christ the King. Ave Maria square was inaugurated on 14 September 2011.

Work started on 3 September 1928. The provincial digital guide dates the inauguration to 14 March 1933 in one sentence and the founding to 14 May 1933 in the contact block. Keep both. This is a working church. The visit is the square and the stone front, not a ticketed museum.
